exceptions.reason: Metro's image-size parser is reachable only in build-time tooling; runtime and build inputs are restricted to trusted repository assets, and external or user-supplied asset bytes must not be passed to Metro.
exceptions.removeWhen: Remove when image-size publishes a patched release or an Expo SDK update replaces the affected Metro dependency.
exceptions.operationalConstraint: Metro build inputs may come only from trusted repository assets; external and user-supplied assets must not be passed to Metro.
